slides.heading: Worth an assessment if

caption:
Toto does ten minutes of toe touches before every run. Does it actually stop injuries?

Research suggests static stretching on its own doesn't reliably lower injury risk for most sports. It isn't harmful and plenty of people enjoy it, but it's not the shield many of us grew up believing in. What has stronger support is strength training and a moving warm-up: leg swings, lunges, skips and some gradually faster efforts for five to ten minutes. If your sport needs big range, like dance or martial arts, flexibility work still has a clear place.

A pop, swelling, bruising or tightness that keeps returning is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🏃
